name: River Manta
lore: Nom seul dans la source : silhouette et construction proposées pour le jeu, sans validation canonique ni statistiques inventées.

assets.label: River Manta — proposition de châssis
assets.prompt: Design an original modular vehicle for the 2D Yautja fan-game La Longue Chasse from its NAME-ONLY brief. This is an explicit new design proposal, not a reconstruction of an existing canonical film vehicle. Exactly TWO full side-profile views SIDE BY SIDE: left craft points RIGHT, right craft LEFT; identical construction and scale, separately drawn opposite sides. Full silhouette within each half, wide margins. Pure MAGENTA #FF00FF background. Detailed painted game bitmap, dark alien bronze/gunmetal hardware with subtle small status lamps. NO scenery, ground shadow, text, layout labels, rider, passenger, cargo, trophy or effects. Empty hardware sockets for detachable modules, no baked-in weapons. A small river-going alien hydrofoil skimmer with a broad flattened manta-like hull, low central empty pilot recess and short handlebars, curved front bow with a flat bumper, protected underside twin folding hydrofoil blades STOWED horizontally, shallow outboard stabilization sponsons and rear water-jet nozzle. Teal-black metal and bronze trim, subtle weathering. This is a machine, not a biological manta animal; no fins growing as flesh. Side view with a mild elevation only enough to read low wide hull; no top-down camera.
notes: Le nom est demandé ; les choix mécaniques sont des propositions originales à valider.
Deux vues statiques en revue, aucun clip runtime. Pilote, armes et effets doivent rester indépendants.
